text: If you were born as Carl Johnson from GTA San Andreas, you'd come home for your mother's funeral, get framed by a crooked cop in five minutes, then end up running half the state.
And the two guys who sold out your whole neighborhood? You grew up with them.

You grow up on Grove Street in Los Santos, with your mom, your big brother Sweet, your little sister Kendl, and your brother Brian. When Brian dies, Sweet blames you. So you leave. Five years in Liberty City.

Then your mom is killed in a drive-by, and you fly home for the funeral. Two cops pick you up at the airport. Officer Tenpenny takes your money, frames you for murder, and drops you in enemy gang territory. With a bike. Remember Tenpenny.
